description: Pre-baked DART gesture vocabulary for the avatar. Each gesture is a DART text->motion clip generated once on the RTX box and converted to a normalized-VRM GLB via tools/dart_to_glb.py (--face-camera). The GLBs are per-machine runtime assets (gitignored) and regenerable with tools/build_dart_gestures.py. 'triggers' maps Kokoro emotion/intent labels to the gesture for embodiment playback (Phase 5.1). 'prompt' is the DART text prompt; 'primitives' is the *N rollout length (~8 primitives ~= 2.2s @ 30fps).

gestures.name: wave
gestures.note: Hand up beside the head, open palm. Greeting on session start / farewell.

gestures.name: clap
gestures.note: Applause. Celebrating the user / reacting to good news.

gestures.name: point
gestures.note: Deictic point. Directing attention while explaining.

gestures.name: bow
gestures.note: Forward torso bow (spine pitch; in-place). Thanks / sorry.

gestures.name: shrug
gestures.note: Shoulders up, palms out. 'I don't know.'
